primitives.name: Source Clone Validation Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Other plausible clones were found, but this one was selected as the active app clone for evidence because it is the known primary shipping clone and contains the runnable app.
primitives.assumptions: The selected clone is the canonical source of truth for application logic and deployment artifacts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When alternative clones exist with conflicting manifests or unverified build states.

The 'manifest_consistency_check' ensures that the selected clone's metadata aligns with expected application structure, forming a closed-loop verification system. Failure modes include divergent branches, untracked changes, or missing dependencies, which would trigger a re-evaluation of clone validity.
